snippet.title: Darwin's Paradox | Official Launch Trailer | KONAMI (PEGI)
snippet.description:
The fate of the world rests in the many arms of evolution's more perfect specimen...Darwin! Watch as Darwin goes from sneaking past alien guards, blasting ink, and barely escaping terrifying enemies including a very hungry fish.

Darwin's Paradox is available now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.
